capabilities.name: loan-originator-status
capabilities.description: Map a LoanOriginatorStatus enum NAME (ACTIVE/PENDING/INACTIVE) to the STRING value the oracle stores/returns, as returned by GET /loan-originators/template statusOptions and declared in LoanOriginatorStatus.java.
capabilities.evidence: Capture loan-originators-template-raw.json under tenant gerege: the running oracle returned statusOptions ["ACTIVE","INACTIVE","PENDING"], corroborated by loan-originator-status-source.txt (LoanOriginatorStatus.java ACTIVE("ACTIVE"), PENDING("PENDING"), INACTIVE("INACTIVE")).

seams.name: origination-loan-originator-status
seams.description: GET /loan-originators/template statusOptions on the running Fineract server, tenant gerege: the LoanOriginatorStatus string vocabulary.

note: Origination parity-store capability registry. Each capabilities_required name on a vector must map, on the vector's seam, to status exercised, and the capability must be in the graded domain, else the vector is refused (default-deny). One capability is graded: the LoanOriginatorStatus name-to-stored-string mapping (origination-loan-originator-status seam). No money, minor-unit, or rounding surface exists in this context; the only graded cell is the stored status string.
